paper_title: The Grenoble Axion Haloscope platform (GrAHal): development plan and first results
notes: Single-point measurement from pathfinding run at liquid He temperature. Fixed cavity at 6.375 GHz (26.37 µeV) with limited tuning range (six tuning steps from He exchange gas pressure adjustment). Exclusion limit at minimum of curve shown in Figure 4. Combined spectrum from 6 tuning steps with 3σ detection threshold applied; no signals detected above threshold. Assumes axions constitute all local dark matter density (ρa). First experimental result from GrAHal collaboration, establishing new exclusion limit that extends beyond previous constraints in this mass region.
